cards.name: logging scan times with ID: 5
cards.desc: As a system auditor, I want every RFID scan event to persist the card UID, scanner ID, and server-received timestamp so that IMPRINT can provide a reliable, queryable audit trail.

items.name: Backend scan_events schema stores card_uid, scanner_id, and received_at timestamp
Backend scan ingest endpoint saves one row per accepted RFID scan
Automated tests verify timezone-safe timestamp serialization and retrieval

cards.name: Admin Page: 3
cards.desc: As an IMPRINT administrator, I want a centralized web-dashboard admin page so that I can manage cards, scanners, and monitor platform health from one place.

items.name: Admin-only routes are protected by backend authorization checks
Web dashboard shows scanner inventory and card management controls
Admin page is wired to backend management APIs for create/update/delete actions

cards.name: Secure Login: 2
cards.desc: As a dashboard user, I want secure authentication so that IMPRINT access to RFID and scanner data remains protected.

items.name: Passwords are hashed with a modern salted algorithm before database storage
Session or JWT tokens are signed and validated by backend auth middleware
Login endpoint and dashboard auth flow are documented for HTTPS-only deployment

cards.name: Wrong Username/Password Messages
cards.desc: As a dashboard user, I want clear and accessible login failure messages so that I can correct credential mistakes quickly without exposing sensitive details.

items.name: Dashboard login form renders non-specific invalid-credentials feedback
Error messaging uses accessible aria-live regions for assistive technologies
Username and password inputs show consistent inline validation states

cards.name: Device Authentication: 2
cards.desc: As an IMPRINT developer, I want each scanner to authenticate with a unique device secret so that only trusted hardware can submit RFID scans.

items.name: Scanner identity and per-device secret are stored and rotatable in backend data store
Firmware includes authenticated handshake when posting scan events
Backend rejects unauthenticated scanner requests with explicit 401 responses

cards.name: Export data as a csv
cards.desc: As an operations manager, I want to export scan logs as CSV so that I can analyze RFID activity outside the dashboard.

items.name: CSV export includes scanner ID, card UID, result, and timestamp columns
Dashboard export action calls backend endpoint and downloads a valid CSV file
Export supports filtering by date range and site when query params are provided

cards.name: Firmware - Provisioning QR flow
cards.desc: As a field technician, I want to provision an IMPRINT scanner from a QR payload so that device setup is repeatable and low-friction.

items.name: Provisioning payload format includes API host, scanner ID, and bootstrap secret
Firmware parses QR payload and stores provisioning values safely
Provisioned device confirms success and can authenticate to backend

cards.name: Auth Logging Policy: redact secrets
cards.desc: As a security engineer, I want IMPRINT auth logs to redact secrets and personal data so that observability remains useful without leaking sensitive information.

items.name: Backend logging middleware redacts password, token, and secret fields before write
Log review confirms no raw credentials or secrets appear in auth traces

cards.name: Retention Policy: purge job
cards.desc: As a DevOps engineer, I want an automated retention job for IMPRINT logs so that storage stays controlled and policy-compliant.

items.name: Scheduled purge job deletes scan/auth logs older than configured retention window
Dry-run mode records candidate deletions for safe verification before production enablement

cards.name: Adjust NavBar to be a drawer
cards.desc: As a mobile dashboard user, I want the navigation to collapse into a drawer so that IMPRINT pages remain usable on small screens.

items.name: Responsive breakpoint switches desktop nav to a drawer on small viewports
Drawer supports keyboard and touch interactions for accessibility
Drawer layering is verified against modals and page content

cards.name: Events Graph
cards.desc: As an analyst, I want an events graph in the web dashboard so that I can quickly understand RFID scan trends over time.

items.name: Dashboard chart visualizes scan event counts over selectable intervals
Backend aggregation endpoint returns grouped scan metrics efficiently
Chart includes tooltips and legends for scanner/site context

cards.name: Chart with Calendar that shows heat map
cards.desc: As a site manager, I want a calendar heatmap of scan volume so that I can identify unusually high or low RFID activity days.

items.name: Heatmap color scale maps daily scan volume to clear intensity bands
Calendar view responds to selected date range and site filters

cards.name: Feature: Secure Account Creation
cards.desc: As a new IMPRINT admin user, I want a secure account creation flow so that dashboard access starts with safe credential handling and validation.

items.name: Implemented bcrypt password hashing before user persistence
Implemented unique username validation in account creation path
Implemented verified database write for newly created accounts
